value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: Hard Existence(at_goal) and Precedence(has_key, at_goal) already force has_key before reaching the goal. The task says “Pick up the key, then reach the goal,” so hard Existence(has_key) is also required; without it, the clauses only require the key if the agent reaches the goal, and a run can finish without reaching the goal or picking up the key.
CHANGES REQUIRED: hard Existence(has_key) repeats what hard Existence(at_goal) plus hard Precedence(has_key, at_goal) already forces. Remove Existence(has_key); keep the goal requirement and order.
NO CHANGES NEEDED: Existence(at_goal) requires reaching the goal, and Precedence(has_key, at_goal) requires acquiring the key first.
